questions.question: Two angles that share a side and add to 180 degrees are called what?
questions.explanation: Adjacent angles on a straight line add to 180 degrees.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: A straight line is 180 degrees.

questions.question: What is the sum of the interior angles of a quadrilateral?
questions.explanation: The sum is (n - 2) times 180, and for n = 4 that is 360 degrees.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Quadrilaterals add to 360.

questions.question: What is the sum of the interior angles of a pentagon?
questions.explanation: (5 - 2) times 180 = 540 degrees.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Use (n minus 2) times 180.

questions.question: How many sides does a hexagon have?
questions.explanation: Hex means six, so a hexagon has 6 sides.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Hex means six.

questions.question: What type of triangle has all three sides equal?
questions.explanation: Equilateral means equal sides: all three sides are the same length, so all three angles are also equal, 60 degrees each.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Equi means equal.

questions.question: What type of triangle has exactly two equal sides?
questions.explanation: An isosceles triangle has exactly two equal sides, and the angles opposite those sides (the base angles) are equal too. Three equal sides would make it equilateral instead.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Iso means same, two sides match.

questions.question: What is the midpoint of the segment from (2, 4) to (6, 10)?
questions.explanation: Average the x values: (2+6)/2 = 4. Average the y values: (4+10)/2 = 7.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: The midpoint is the average of the endpoints.

questions.question: What is the distance between (0, 0) and (3, 4)?
questions.explanation: Use the distance formula: the square root of (9 + 16) is 5.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: 3-4-5 is a classic right triangle.

questions.question: A line has slope 3. What is the slope of a line perpendicular to it?
questions.explanation: Perpendicular slopes are opposite reciprocals.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Flip the fraction and change the sign.

questions.question: A line has slope 2/3. What is the slope of a line parallel to it?
questions.explanation: Parallel lines have the same slope.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Parallel lines never meet and share a slope.

questions.question: What is the measure of each interior angle of a regular hexagon?
questions.explanation: The interior sum is 720 degrees; divide by 6 sides to get 120 degrees.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Divide the total by the number of sides.

questions.question: What is the measure of each interior angle of a regular pentagon?
questions.explanation: The interior sum is 540 degrees; divide by 5 to get 108 degrees.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Divide the total by the number of sides.

questions.question: In a right triangle, the side opposite the right angle is called what?
questions.explanation: The hypotenuse is the longest side, opposite the right angle.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Hypotenuse is the longest side.

questions.question: What transformation flips a figure over a line?
questions.explanation: A reflection creates a mirror image: every point of the figure and its image are the same distance from the mirror line, on opposite sides of it.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Reflection is a mirror flip.

questions.question: What transformation turns a figure around a point?
questions.explanation: A rotation turns every point of a figure by the same angle around one fixed point, called the center of rotation, like the hands of a clock.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Rotation spins the figure.

questions.question: What transformation slides a figure without turning it?
questions.explanation: A translation slides every point the same distance in the same direction.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Translation is a slide.

questions.question: What transformation changes the size of a figure?
questions.explanation: A dilation enlarges or reduces a figure by a scale factor.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Dilation changes size.

questions.question: What is the scale factor if a figure is enlarged to twice its size?
questions.explanation: The scale factor is image length divided by original length. Doubling every length gives 2/1 = 2; a scale factor under 1 would shrink the figure.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Scale factor 2 doubles every length.

questions.question: Two triangles are congruent. What does that mean?
questions.correctAnswer: They have the same size and shape
distractors: They have the same area only
They are similar but different sizes
questions.explanation: Congruent figures match exactly: every corresponding side and angle is equal, so one figure can be placed on top of the other with no overlap or gap.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Congruent means exactly the same.

questions.question: Which postulate proves two triangles congruent with two sides and the included angle?
questions.explanation: SAS means side-angle-side, with the angle between the two sides.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: SAS needs the angle between the sides.

questions.question: Which postulate proves two triangles congruent with three sides?
questions.explanation: SSS = Side-Side-Side: if all three sides of one triangle equal the three sides of another, the triangles are congruent, because three fixed side lengths determine a triangle's shape completely.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Three matching sides prove congruence.

questions.question: What does SSS stand for?
questions.explanation: SSS stands for Side-Side-Side: the three letters name the three known matching parts, one side of the triangle for each S.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: SSS is three sides.

questions.question: What is the volume of a cube with side 4 cm?
questions.explanation: Volume is side cubed: 4 times 4 times 4 = 64.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Cube volume is side cubed.

questions.question: What is the surface area of a cube with side 3 cm?
questions.explanation: Each face is 9 square cm and there are 6 faces: 6 times 9 = 54.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: A cube has six faces.

questions.question: What is the area of a parallelogram with base 9 cm and height 5 cm?
questions.explanation: Area is base times height: 9 times 5 = 45.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Parallelogram area is base times height.

questions.question: What is the area of a trapezoid with bases 6 and 10 and height 4?
questions.explanation: Area is 1/2 times height times (base1 + base2): 1/2 times 4 times 16 = 32.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Average the bases, then multiply by height.

questions.question: If two angles are vertical angles, what is true about them?
questions.explanation: Vertical angles are opposite each other and always equal.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Vertical angles are equal.

questions.question: What is the measure of a right angle?
questions.explanation: A right angle is a quarter of a full turn: 360/4 = 90 degrees. It is the corner angle of a square, marked with a small square in diagrams.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Right means 90.

questions.question: What is the measure of a straight angle?
questions.explanation: A straight angle is a straight line, 180 degrees.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Straight means 180.

questions.question: What is the longest side of a right triangle called, and what is its length if the legs are 6 and 8?
questions.explanation: By the Pythagorean theorem, the square root of (36 + 64) is 10, and that side is the hypotenuse.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: 6-8-10 is a scaled 3-4-5 triangle.

questions.question: What is the measure of each exterior angle of a regular 10-sided polygon?
questions.explanation: Exterior angles of any polygon add to 360, so 360/10 = 36.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Exterior angles always add to 360.

questions.question: What is the measure of each exterior angle of a regular 12-sided polygon?
questions.explanation: Exterior angles of any polygon add to 360, so 360/12 = 30.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Exterior angles always add to 360.

questions.question: What is the sum of the interior angles of an octagon?
questions.explanation: (8 - 2) times 180 = 1080 degrees.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Use (n minus 2) times 180.

questions.question: What is the distance between (1, 1) and (4, 5)?
questions.explanation: The square root of (9 + 16) is 5.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: 3-4-5 is a classic right triangle.

questions.question: What is the measure of each exterior angle of a regular 8-sided polygon?
questions.explanation: Exterior angles of any polygon add to 360, so 360/8 = 45.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Exterior angles always add to 360.

questions.question: What is the complement of a 35-degree angle?
questions.explanation: Complementary angles add to 90: 90 - 35 = 55.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Complementary angles add to 90.

questions.question: What is the slope of the line through (3, 2) and (6, 5)?
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Slope is rise over run.

questions.question: What is the diameter of a circle with radius 7 cm?
questions.explanation: Diameter is twice the radius: 2 times 7 = 14.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Diameter is double the radius.

questions.question: What is the radius of a circle with diameter 20 cm?
questions.explanation: Radius is half the diameter: 20/2 = 10.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Radius is half the diameter.

questions.question: How many degrees are in a full circle?
questions.explanation: A full turn is 360 degrees - four right angles of 90 degrees each. Degrees divide one full rotation into 360 equal parts.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: A full circle is 360.

questions.question: What do you call a polygon with 8 sides?
questions.explanation: Oct means eight, so an 8-sided polygon is an octagon.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Oct means eight.
